messages.text: You are supposed to push the file up to the repo and give me a git pages link

To get your GitHub Pages link, do this yourself (takes ~3 minutes):

1. Sign in to GitHub (or create a free account).
2. Create a new public repository, e.g. named `tictactoe` — no README needed.
3. In the repo, click "Add file" → "Upload files" and upload your `tictactoe.html`. Tip: rename it to `index.html` so the game loads at the root address.
4. Go to the repo's Settings → Pages. Under "Build and deployment", choose "Deploy from a branch", select the `main` branch and `/ (root)` folder, then Save.
5. Wait about a minute, then your game is live at: `https://<your-username>.github.io/tictactoe/` (if renamed to index.html) or `https://<your-username>.github.io/tictactoe/tictactoe.html` (if kept as-is).

That link is playable by anyone on any device — though remember the game is local pass-and-play, so two players share one screen.

Paste the live URL back here and I'll log it in the plan's ledger as the official hosted address.
